name: Traditional Flan Custard
method: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F.
To prepare caramel sauce, pour sugar into a pan over the medium heat. Stir constantly.
When it is brown and fully melted, it will become caramel.
Once the color reaches golden brown, transfer it to the pie plate.
To prepare the custard, whisk the eggs for one minute or until they are frothy.
Gradually put condensed milk in it, then the evaporated milk. Slowly mix the vanilla and sugar.
To bake the flan, put the custard mixture in the caramel pie plate.
Put the pie plate in a baking dish.
Bake the flan for around 45 minutes. Use a knife to check its status. If it is clean, then your flan is ready.
Remove the flan from the baking dish. Let it cool for overnight in the refrigerator for better taste.
